title: AIOS Integration Framework v1 — closed capability taxonomy
description: Closed v1 capability identifiers, profile membership, capability classes, canonical conformance test ids, and machine-checkable dependency rules. AIO-835 Phase 0. A change to any identifier, class, profile membership, dependency rule, or canonical test id requires a contract-version change and updated fixtures.

capability_classes.write: Creates or modifies provider state and requires readback verification.
capability_classes.destructive: Removes provider state or revokes access; separately permissioned from write.
capability_classes.admin: Changes installation or configuration posture rather than provider work data.

manifest.title: Manifest/schema
manifest.description: Required metadata, unique registration, capability/test correspondence, version compatibility, generated catalog/docs parity.

boundary.title: Boundary/routing
boundary.description: Public entrypoint only, no deep imports or copied clients, root resolution, skill and hook routing generated from the registry.

credentials.title: Credential safety
credentials.description: Secret-source precedence, explicit ambient opt-in, redaction, OAuth state/host checks, uninstall/revoke, no secret leakage.

capability.title: Capability contract
capability.description: Normalized reads, typed unsupported/ambiguous/stale results, exact relation semantics, hierarchy, status, assignment, comments, and capability denial.

mutation.title: Mutation safety
mutation.description: Readback verification, idempotent create/update/remove, duplicate prevention, no unsafe mutation retries, partial-failure recovery.

resilience.title: Resilience
resilience.description: Rate-limit unit fixtures, retry/backoff, pagination completeness, timeout/cancellation, malformed provider responses, webhook replay and ordering.

sync.title: Sync integrity
sync.description: Stable identity, fingerprint no-op, parent-first projection, provenance, loop prevention, concurrent-edit conflict, tombstone/missing-remote behavior.

lifecycle.title: Black-box lifecycle
lifecycle.description: install -> configure -> validate -> health -> use -> upgrade -> revoke/uninstall from outside the source checkout.

live.title: Live disposable-sandbox certification
live.description: Required before a connector is promoted from experimental. Never a pull-request merge gate.

boundary.public-route.title: Consumers reach the connector only through its public route.

manifest.registry-parity.title: Generated catalog, docs, skill routes, and hook policy match the manifest registry.

compatibility.truth-table.title: Host/manifest and Harness policy compatibility results match compatibility.json.

contract.outcomes.title: Every operation returns exactly one normalized discriminant that validates against outcomes.schema.json.

core.identity.title: Authenticated identity is readable and returned redacted.

core.health.title: Health reports partial installation as unhealthy without leaking provider payloads.

pm.work-item-read.title: Work items normalize to provider-neutral fields with stable external identity.

pm.document-read.title: Provider documents normalize and carry provenance.

pm.state-transition.title: State transitions resolve named states and read back the resulting state id.

pm.assignee-set.title: Assignment resolves an actor identity and reads it back.

pm.comment-create.title: Comment creation returns a stable comment id and provenance.

pm.relations.title: Directional blockers preserve source and target exactly; symmetric related links match in either order.

pm.hierarchy.title: Parent-before-child ordering is preserved and hierarchy cycles fail closed.

mutation.readback.title: Every successful mutation is read back against stable identity and requested fields.

mutation.ambiguity.title: Ambiguous mutations are typed and never automatically replayed.

pm.work-item-create.title: Creation is duplicate-safe under the declared idempotency strategy.

pm.work-item-update.title: Updates are idempotent and surface stale versions rather than overwriting.

pm.relation-remove-idempotent.title: Removing an absent relation is an idempotent no-op.

resilience.pagination.title: Paginated reads are complete or return the declared truncation outcome.

resilience.rate-limit.title: Provider rate-limit units are normalized before time comparison and backoff honors the reset window.

security.credentials.title: Credential source is deterministic, ambient credentials require explicit opt-in, and every surface is redacted.

security.tenant-isolation.title: One team's connector cannot read, mutate, health-check, or revoke another team's integration.

security.events.title: OAuth state and webhook signature, expiry, replay, and ordering behavior are enforced.

security.execution-boundary.title: Paths are canonicalized before containment checks and subprocesses use argument arrays with trusted executable resolution.

sync.no-echo.title: Provenance and projection fingerprints prevent echo loops and unchanged input performs no provider writes.

sync.concurrent-conflict.title: Concurrent edits surface a typed conflict with no automatic winner.

security.content-ingest.title: Access tier and audience only narrow on ingest and provider rich text is sanitized before use.

lifecycle.black-box.title: Install, upgrade, and uninstall are atomic or recoverable from outside the source checkout.

lifecycle.validate.title: Validation reports configuration and credential readiness without mutating provider state.

lifecycle.revoke.title: Revoke removes routing and local credentials without deleting remote data.

live.cleanup.title: Live sandbox inventory reaches zero active prefixed objects and the disposable credential is revoked.

core.title: Core
core.description: Applies to every connector regardless of domain.

pm.title: Product Management
pm.description: Normalized work-item semantics, hierarchy, directional blockers, bidirectional related links, statuses, assignment, comments, and sync conflict handling.

dependency_rules.requires_manifest_note: Values are JSON Pointers into the manifest. Each must resolve to `true` or to a non-empty array.
notes: Every PM mutation requires pm.work_item.read; the per-capability requires_all entries are the machine-checkable form of that rule.
Capability ids outside this closed set are rejected unless they match extension_namespace_pattern.
Extension capabilities can never satisfy a dependency here and never drive normalized orchestration decisions.
Profile membership is additive: every capability of every declared profile appears exactly once in supported or unsupported. Omission is invalid.
always_required capabilities may never appear in unsupported.
A capability marked paginated:true requires a manifest-level pagination block with an explicit completeness limit and truncation outcome.

baseline_tests_note: Run by every connector regardless of declared capabilities. The eight non-live suites are required for every connector, so conformance.suites must list all of them.
conditional_tests_note: Condition names are a closed set understood by the contract validator; an unrecognized name is a hard failure rather than a silently skipped requirement.
